subject: organic
question:
有机化学·保护基化学：下列哪组反应条件能够脱除所示保护基：Trifluoroacetamide（trifluoroacetamide）？
A. K₂CO₃, MeOH
B. Zn, AcOH
C. TFA, CH₂Cl₂
D. BBr₃, CH₂Cl₂
explanation: An amide made labile by its CF₃ group: mild base (K₂CO₃ in MeOH, or LiOH) removes it, unlike an acetamide. The CF₃ group makes the amide carbonyl reactive enough for methoxide.
